name: VelaTerm
where_agents_run: your machine + remote machines over SSH (or joined to your account with vela-server); phone or any browser through a pairing link
source_note: Checked against its README, package.json, the file tree, all 16 English user-manual chapters and the changelog on velaterm.com/docs, and the v0.2.6 release page (2026-09-30). Not installed or run here.

multi_provider_supervision.value: 14 agents, each run as a managed session

harness_count.value: 14, including Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Copilot, Cursor

needs_you_signal.value: Status dots, system notification, unread badge

approve_deny_prompt.value: Allow and Deny cards in chat view, also from a phone browser

cross_provider_delegation.value: Child sessions on any of four agents, under the parent

conversation_gui_view.value: Chat view for 5 agents; switch to terminal view anytime

real_terminal.value: Every session is a real terminal that keeps running

prompt_scratchpad.value: Unsent text and queued messages kept; no drafts pad

saved_prompt_library.value: Presets save launch settings, not prompts

builtin_editors_browser.value: Markdown and code editors, image viewer, browser tab

appearance_control.value: Light/dark, accent; interface, terminal and chat fonts

usage_hud.value: Plan usage and reset times for Claude, Codex, Grok

burn_rate_forecast.value: Usage and resets only; no forecast in docs

limit_governor.value: Resumes after a limit resets; no pause before it

account_hotswap.value: Sign in again or out; no switching in docs

vault_task_source.value: Agents can search an Obsidian vault; not a task list

issue_tracker_pipeline.value: Not in its docs; merges branches locally, no PRs

worktree_management.value: Optional worktree per child session, graphical merge

planner_orchestrator.value: Planner splits the task; you edit; agents build in parallel

agent_to_agent_messaging.value: Sessions search, read and message each other

knowledge_base.value: Agents search session notes, your Markdown, a code graph

native_mobile_app.value: iOS and Android app in development, not yet published

phone_no_new_app.value: Phone browser via a pairing link, encrypted

remote_ssh.value: SSH to Linux, macOS or Windows; sessions keep running there

os.value: Windows, macOS, Linux; any browser; phone app not yet published

app_shell.value: Tauri 2 on macOS and Windows; Electron on Linux since v0.2.6

background_process.value: None locally; SSH hosts run a vela-server process

download_size.value: v0.2.6: 59.5 MB Windows min / 148 MB full setup, 49.8-51.1 MB macOS dmg, 140-142 MB Linux AppImage

ram_vs_claude_desktop.value: Small (estimate: Tauri app on the system WebView; Linux build is Electron)

license_cost.value: MIT, free, uses your own subscriptions

extensibility.value: Scriptable session commands and agent skills; no plugin API

teams_multiuser.value: Not in its docs; sharing is only between your devices

stability_maturity.value: v0.2.6 (2026-09-30); public since July 2026, near-daily releases; account sharing experimental
